# JapanMust

> Practical knowledge for first-time visitors to Japan: how restaurant ordering actually works, what dishes really are, and everyday travel logistics. Written from real experience — no fluff, no listicles.

JapanMust explains the things that confuse first-time visitors most: restaurant systems, menus, dishes, and everyday logistics. Every guide is written from real experience. Dish explanations tell you what's actually in front of you — not a dictionary guess. The site currently has 23 in-depth guides (including printable Japanese food allergy cards) and 10 explained dishes. JapanMust also builds Japan Interpreter, an offline English-to-Japanese translator app for travelers (launching soon).

## Guides

- [How to Order Ramen Without Speaking Japanese](https://japanmust.com/guides/how-to-order-ramen/): Ticket machines, seating, the 5 phrases that cover 90% of ramen shops, etiquette.
- [Izakaya Guide](https://japanmust.com/guides/izakaya-guide/): How Japanese izakaya pubs work — ordering, seating charges, etiquette.
- [English Menus in Japan](https://japanmust.com/guides/english-menus/): Where to find English menus and what to do when there isn't one.
- [How to Ask for the Bill](https://japanmust.com/guides/ask-for-bill/): Paying at Japanese restaurants — phrases, cash vs card, no tipping.
- [Konbini Food Guide](https://japanmust.com/guides/konbini-food/): Making the most of Japanese convenience stores — what to eat, how to pay, microwave etiquette.
- [No-WiFi Survival Guide](https://japanmust.com/guides/no-wifi-survival/): Staying connected and navigating Japan without WiFi.
- [How to Read a Japanese Menu](https://japanmust.com/guides/read-japanese-menu/): Decoding Japanese menus — kanji basics, common terms, what the dish actually is.
- [Sushi Ordering Guide](https://japanmust.com/guides/sushi-ordering/): Ordering sushi in Japan — conveyor belt vs counter, etiquette, useful phrases.
- [Food Allergies in Japan](https://japanmust.com/guides/food-allergies/): Communicating food allergies in Japanese restaurants — key phrases and what to watch for.
- [eSIM and Pocket WiFi](https://japanmust.com/guides/esim-pocket-wifi/): Staying connected in Japan — eSIM vs pocket WiFi vs local SIM.
### Allergy cards and offline translation

- [Printable Japanese food allergy card (pick your allergens)](https://japanmust.com/guides/japanese-food-allergy-card-printable/): Tick your allergens, print one card, hand it to the staff.
- [Peanut allergy in Japan: restaurant card & phrases](https://japanmust.com/guides/peanut-allergy-japan-restaurant-card/): Where peanuts hide in Japan, with a restaurant card.
- [How to say “I’m allergic to shellfish” in Japanese](https://japanmust.com/guides/shellfish-allergy-japanese-phrases/): Shrimp, crab and shellfish phrases plus dishes to watch.
- [Gluten-free in Japan: restaurant card for celiacs](https://japanmust.com/guides/gluten-free-japan-restaurant-card/): Soy sauce contains wheat, and what to do about it.
- [Egg allergy in Japan: hidden egg and a restaurant card](https://japanmust.com/guides/egg-allergy-japan-restaurant-card/): Tempura batter, mayo and binders: where egg hides.
- [Dairy and milk allergy in Japan: restaurant card](https://japanmust.com/guides/dairy-allergy-japan-restaurant-card/): Washoku is mostly dairy-free; curry roux and bread are not.
- [Soba and buckwheat allergy in Japan](https://japanmust.com/guides/soba-buckwheat-allergy-japan/): Why soba shops are risky and which “soba” is not buckwheat.
- [Tree nut allergy in Japan: restaurant card](https://japanmust.com/guides/tree-nut-allergy-japan-restaurant-card/): Walnut, almond and cashew words and a restaurant card.
- [Soy allergy in Japan: soy sauce, miso and tofu](https://japanmust.com/guides/soy-allergy-japan-soy-sauce/): Soy sauce, miso and tofu are everywhere. How to cope.
- [Does Japanese food contain fish? Dashi, fish allergy & vegetarian](https://japanmust.com/guides/fish-allergy-dashi-japan/): Dashi is fish stock. A guide for fish allergy and vegetarians.
- [How to read allergen labels on Japanese packaged food](https://japanmust.com/guides/japan-allergen-labels-packaged-food/): Read konbini and supermarket allergen labels in seconds.
- [Japan offline translator: translating with no WiFi](https://japanmust.com/guides/japan-offline-translator-no-wifi/): Set up translation that works with no signal.
- [How to translate a Japanese menu with your camera](https://japanmust.com/guides/translate-japanese-menu-offline-camera/): Photo tips and allergen words to check on every scan.
- [All Guides](https://japanmust.com/guides/): Full index of JapanMust travel guides.

## Dishes, Explained

Not word-for-word translations — what each dish actually is: what's inside, raw or cooked, spicy or not.

- [Oyakodon](https://japanmust.com/dishes/oyakodon/): Chicken and egg rice bowl — what's in it, how it's served.
- [Tonkotsu Ramen](https://japanmust.com/dishes/tonkotsu-ramen/): Rich pork-bone broth ramen — flavor profile, regional origin, what to expect.
- [Takoyaki](https://japanmust.com/dishes/takoyaki/): Octopus balls — what's inside, how they're eaten, where to find the best.
- [Yakitori](https://japanmust.com/dishes/yakitori/): Grilled chicken skewers — cuts, sauce vs salt, how to order.
- [Gyoza](https://japanmust.com/dishes/gyoza/): Japanese pan-fried dumplings — filling, dipping sauce, how they differ from Chinese jiaozi.
- [Tempura](https://japanmust.com/dishes/tempura/): Battered and fried seafood/vegetables — what to expect, tentsuyu dipping sauce.
- [Okonomiyaki](https://japanmust.com/dishes/okonomiyaki/): Savory pancake — Osaka vs Hiroshima style, what's in it.
- [Karaage](https://japanmust.com/dishes/karaage/): Japanese fried chicken — marinade, how it's served.
- [Natto](https://japanmust.com/dishes/natto/): Fermented soybeans — taste, how to eat it, soy allergy notes.
- [Katsudon](https://japanmust.com/dishes/katsudon/): Breaded pork cutlet and egg over rice — ingredients and allergens.
- [All Dishes](https://japanmust.com/dishes/): Full index of explained dishes.
